answer: Each agent burns 40 credits to claim one cedar work slot and locks 70 credits behind it. Each epoch a pulse calls the slot: the agent must deliver a fresh relic, a record only its key can sign. A missed pulse or reused relic burns the bond and frees the slot. First slot costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented relic burns its lender too. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its slot.
